lesson_map.title: What data would support a local decision?
Can we collect an auditable real record?
How does a frequency table preserve a count?
How sensitive is the mean to one value?
When do median and mode answer different questions?
What can grouped counts tell us about the median?
What does a modal class establish?
Why do histogram areas represent counts?
Why can the tallest bar contain fewer observations?
What can a frequency polygon support?
Can our actual data become a checked digital graph?
What recommendation does our evidence warrant?
Which data claims survive an audit?
